reviewed_events.id: Stable event identifier; not a date encoding
reviewed_events.title: Reviewed action headline
reviewed_events.date: Event date: ISO day, month or year; empty means unknown
reviewed_events.date_basis: Evidence and reasoning for event date
reviewed_events.publication_date: Publication date of selected reporting source, not event date
reviewed_events.summary: Original analytical summary of the supported action
reviewed_events.confidence: Qualitative support, not a probability or impact score
reviewed_events.source_count: Number of linked documents, not independent witnesses
reviewed_events.has_primary_source: At least one primary document attached
reviewed_events.source_ids: JSON array of source IDs in CSV; native array in JSONL

event_sources.merge_reason: Reason for evidence association; not a duplicate classification

null_policy: Empty CSV fields mean missing/not recorded. Unknown event dates require date_precision=unknown.
